subject: Post-demo: MedixCare security & contingency follow-up
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@medixcare.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@medixcare.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jul 2025 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: MedixCare security & contingency follow-up

Hi Samir / Olivia —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we have a clear path forward: 

1) SOC 2 posture: can you confirm whether MedixCare requires SOC 2 Type II evidence (and if so, which time window you expect)? We have a Type II letter from 2024 that we can share.

2) Breach notification / IR SLAs: you mentioned internal requirements for a notification window — please confirm whether the expectation is "initial notification within 72 hours" and a follow-up report within 14 days, or whether you need a shorter initial window. For Redwood, our standard is initial notification within 48 hours of detection and a detailed incident report within 10 business days; we can align on contract terms if you need stricter timelines.

3) BCP/DR artifacts: attaching a short BCP summary and an incident timeline template that you can use to validate our processes. If you prefer a deeper runbook, we can provide a redacted runbook under NDA.

4) Vendor security questionnaire: happy to kick off your vendor questionnaire. If you can send the XLSX or a link, we’ll populate it and return within 3 business days for the initial responses.

Next steps proposed:
- MedixCare to confirm SOC 2 requirement window and the breach notification SLA you’ll accept.
- If okay, we’ll schedule an IR intake call (30 minutes) to walk through the notification flow and data residency considerations.

Attaching: redwood-bcp-summary.pdf, vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx (blank copy for you to send back).

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0183

From: Samir Khan <samir.k@medixcare.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@medixcare.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jul 2025 13:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: MedixCare security & contingency follow-up

Thanks, Evelyn — good recap. A couple quick clarifications: 

- MedixCare purchasing generally requires SOC 2 Type II for production connections; our security team will want the most recent 12-month window but can accept a Type II letter dated within the last 18 months if controls coverage is documented.

- Our legal/compliance team is currently pushing for an initial notification within 72 hours of confirmed incident and a substantive follow-up within 21 days. Would Redwood be able to commit contractually to 72 hours initial? If you can do 48 hours that's even better — we just need to document it.

- I attached our standard vendor questionnaire (see filename in-line). If you can populate the first tab and return by EOB Tuesday that would keep us on track for a late-July procurement review.

Also: we have an EU clinic footprint; please highlight any data residency options or EU deployable variants.

Samir
VP Product, MedixCare
samir.k@medixcare.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jul 2025 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MedixCare questionnaire + SOC2 / BCP artifacts (internal)

Eve / Aditya — per Samir's ask, attaching the following redacted artifacts we can share immediately: soc2-typeII-letter-2024.pdf and incident-timeline-template.docx.

Note: SOC 2 letter covers controls through 2024-09-30; our compliance team confirms we can commit to a contractual initial notification target of 48 hours for confirmed incidents, with a standard detailed report delivery within 10 business days. Anything stricter will need an escalation to Legal for SLA exceptions (pricing/credits).

Vendor questionnaire: I’ll take point on filling the security controls tab and will return a first-pass draft by Monday EOD. Evelyn, I’ll copy Samir/Olivia on the returned spreadsheet.

Attachments: soc2-typeII-letter-2024.pdf, incident-timeline-template.docx

Laura Bennett
Senior Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference

- We can provide the SOC 2 Type II letter (attached) and the incident timeline template.

- Data residency: we offer EU-hosted deployments for customers who need it; I'll have the solutions team provide the region-specific config sheet on our intake call.
